messages:
Ivy Ramos: Hey all 12 I'm Ivy, joining as Product Designer on onboarding. Quick blockers: Figma access, where the onboarding roadmap lives, where research synths + recordings are, and I need a Mac setup note (I have a personal M1). Any tips?
Conor (DesignOps): Welcome Ivy :tada: Invite sent to ivy.ramos@redwood.com for Figma and Notion. Roadmap is in Notion under Product > Roadmap > Onboarding. For first-pass reading, please skim the Onboarding Initiative Brief and the Activation funnel doc.
Ivy Ramos: Got the invites email. On the Mac question  do we standardize on Rosetta vs native builds for tools? Also do I need an SSH key for any infra repos?
Pete_IT: For M1 machines we recommend native builds when possible. Install homebrew (arm64) then run our bootstrap:
```
/bin/bash -c "$(curl -fsSL https://bootstrap.redwood.com/setup.sh)"
```
That script installs devkit, zsh config, and prompts to generate an SSH key. If you want a company laptop, DM me; otherwise confirm your laptop complies with the laptop policy.
Asha (Research): Research artifacts: raw recordings + transcripts in Dovetail (project: Onboarding Tests). Synths live in Notion at Research > Syntheses > Onboarding. We prefer a 2-3 bullet TL;DR and a short list of recommended next steps. If you want to shadow the next test, ping me.
Marta_PM: FYI roadmap view has the 6-week plan + open questions board. If you want alignment, I can do a 20m walkthrough Tue 3pm. Also we keep a compact spec checklist in the Product Spec DB for any component changes.
Ivy Ramos: Thanks. Also wondering: where are past usability recordings for signup flows? I couldn't find them in Dovetail search.
Asha (Research): We tag projects by feature_slug (e.g., "onboarding_signup"). If search is noisy, use the filter: Project contains "onboarding_signup" OR Tag equals "signup-usability". We also mirror important clips to Notion cards with timestamps.
Conor (DesignOps): Design critique cadence is Tue 10:30am; design-review channel is #design-review. We have a "new-hire skim" list: 1) Activation funnel doc, 2) Onboarding component library (Figma), 3) Latest usability synth. I'll post that list to #design-intros.
Ivy Ramos: Perfect. One last thing 12 what's the preferred workflow for component changes that touch cross-squad signup UI?
Marta_PM: Create a Product Spec entry, link the Figma prototype, tag eng-review and DS (Maya) for tokens. Small visual tweaks can go through the component library PR process; breaking changes require a rollout plan.
welcome-bot: Automated: added Ivy Ramos to "Design - Product" Figma team and granted Notion read access.
Ivy Ramos: All set, accepted the Figma library and skimmed the onboarding brief. I'll book the Tue 3pm walkthrough and ping @Asha to join a usability shadow. Thanks everyone 60a
